Fetch video metadata and transcript using `yt-dlp` and `youtube-transcript-api` to inspect the video description and transcripts.
```python
script = """
import json
import yt_dlp
from youtube_transcript_api import YouTubeTranscriptApi

ydl_opts = {'skip_download': True}
with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts) as ydl:
    info = ydl.extract_info('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM', download=False)
    print("TITLE:", info.get('title'))
    print("DESCRIPTION:", info.get('description'))

try:
    transcript = YouTubeTranscriptApi.get_transcript('L1vXCYZAYYM')
    print("TRANSCRIPT PREVIEW:", transcript[:5])
    full_text = " ".join([t['text'] for t in transcript])
    print("FULL TRANSCRIPT LENGTH:", len(full_text))
    # print some matching lines
    for line in transcript:
        if any(word in line['text'].lower() for word in ['species', 'bird', 'number', 'highest', 'camera', 'simultaneously', 'record', 'most']):
            print(f"{line['start']}: {line['text']}")
except Exception as e:
    print("TRANSCRIPT ERROR:", e)
"""
await write_file("./get_info.py", script)
res = await run_command("python ./get_info.py")
print(res)
```
